title: LoC Public-Domain Engine — Quarantine Ledger Record
description: A record in the append-only quarantine ledger (ledger/quarantine.jsonl) documenting a single item not cleared by the rights-gate, with its exclusion reason and supporting metadata.

locId.description: The Library of Congress item identifier (unique within LoC's system, e.g. 'sn86053018/00202191664/1903070101/0001').

reason.description: Categorical reason for quarantine: 'restricted' (access/copyright restriction), 'undetermined' (rights status unclear per LoC), 'needs-review' (borderline case requiring expert adjudication), 'sensitive-hold' (cultural/privacy screen flag).

reasonMessage.description: Human-readable explanation of the exclusion, suitable for display to reviewers and external observers.
examples: Rights determination is undetermined per LoC metadata
Access is restricted due to copyright or other restrictions
Publication date present but ambiguous; requires expert review for pre-1929 eligibility
Flagged by cultural-sensitivity screen: content touches on restricted cultural material

collection.description: Name of the LoC collection or source from which the item originates (e.g., 'Chronicling America').
examples: Chronicling America - Select Hawaiian Newspapers and Guides

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp (UTC) indicating when the item was evaluated and recorded in the quarantine ledger.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdictional scope of the rights determination (default 'US'). Determines applicable copyright term.

metadata.description: Optional contextual metadata from the LoC API response that informed the exclusion decision.

rights.description: LoC 'rights' field value (e.g., a rightsstatements.org URI or internal LoC rights statement).

access_restricted.description: LoC 'access_restricted' field; indicates item has explicit access restrictions.

item_rights.description: Item-level rights determination (may differ from or override collection-level).

date.description: Publication or creation date from item metadata (may be approximate or have uncertainty markers).

derivative_status.description: Assessment of whether the item is a derivative work or the original (relevant for PD-by-date analysis).

sensitivity_flag.description: Flag applied by the cultural-sensitivity/privacy screen if 'reason' is 'sensitive-hold'.

collection_identifier.description: Collection identifier or name in LoC's system.

reviewer_note.description: Optional note added by a rights reviewer or cultural reviewer if the item is re-evaluated in a later run or during expert adjudication.
